membership.pairing_plane: BLE may establish friendship/provisioning where supported
membership.identity_policy: admitted swarm peers are trusted members
membership.unknown_peer: not automatically promoted to trusted membership

packet_sanity.purpose: transport/data hygiene, not distrust of the paired peer

model_rule: trusted fresh sane peer data may influence JANUS; stale/invalid packets may not
peer_disagreement: preserve as learning/anomaly evidence, not as loss of friendship
